name: medical-training-backend
description: Comprehensive medical training platform with NestJS backend and React client

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:client: cd client && PORT=4001 REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:4005/api npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:client && npm run test:admin
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:admin
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:client && npm run format:admin

author: Medical Training Team
